fee_notes: Standard Initial Fee is $40,000 per Restaurant, uniform for all franchises. Under a Development Agreement, the Initial Fee for the second and each subsequent Restaurant is reduced to $30,000, with a $20,000 Development Fee per Restaurant credited against the Initial Fee. Under the 2025-2026 Incentive Program, the Initial Fee is further reduced to $20,000 per Restaurant opened prior to December 31, 2026, and the Development Fee is deferred and possibly abated. Turnkey Restaurants also require payment of the $40,000 Initial Fee in addition to the purchase price. Fees may be lower or higher at franchisor's sole discretion based on non-traditional location, new market, incentive programs, territory size, or franchisee experience.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee for each Restaurant is $40,000 (the "Initial Fee"). ... As a benefit of signing the Development Agreement, the Initial Fee for the second and each subsequent Restaurant developed under the same Development Agreement will be reduced by us to $30,000. ... the Initial Fee for each Restaurant opened prior to December 31, 2026 ("2025-2026 IP Deadline") shall be reduced to $20,000.
